BEGIN;
LOCK TABLE student_hybrid_application,student_hybrid_application_receipt,student_learning_intent IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;
DO $$ BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM student_learning_intent) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM student_hybrid_application) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM student_hybrid_application_receipt) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'refusing rollback: Student learner intent and hybrid application provenance must be preserved';
 END IF;
END; $$;
ALTER TABLE student_learning_intent DROP CONSTRAINT student_learning_intent_consumption_receipt;
DROP TABLE student_hybrid_application_receipt;
DROP TABLE student_hybrid_application;
DROP TABLE student_learning_intent;
DROP FUNCTION protect_student_learning_intent();
DROP FUNCTION protect_student_hybrid_immutable();
COMMIT;
